name: Ravenkeeper
ability: If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
designRole: Rewards dying at night with a chosen character-information check.
explanation: Rewards dying at night with a chosen character-information check.

nightInstructions.otherNights: If the Ravenkeeper died tonight, the Ravenkeeper chooses a player. Show that player's character token.

jinxes.reason: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
Each night*, Riot chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Ravenkeeper uses their ability but does not die.
